9:1.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

9:2.web: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.
9:2.kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

9:3.web: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
9:3.kjv: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.

9:4.web: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.
9:4.kjv: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

9:5.web: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
9:5.kjv: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

9:6.web: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.
9:6.kjv: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.

9:7.web: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
9:7.kjv: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

9:8.web: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.
9:8.kjv: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.

9:9.web: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
9:9.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.

9:10.web: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.
9:10.kjv: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

9:11.web: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
9:11.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?

9:12.web: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?
9:12.kjv: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

9:13.web: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”
9:13.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.

9:14.web: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.
9:14.kjv: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

9:15.web: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.
9:15.kjv: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.

9:16.web: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”
9:16.kjv: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

9:17.web: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;
9:17.kjv: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

bsb: it throws him to the ground.
9:18.web: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down, and he foams at the mouth, and grinds his teeth, and wastes away. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”
9:18.kjv: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

9:19.web: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”
9:19.kjv: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

bsb: threw the boy into a convulsion.
9:20.web: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him, and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.
9:20.kjv: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

9:21.web: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has come to him?” He said, “From childhood.
9:21.kjv: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

9:22.web: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water, to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.”
9:22.kjv: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

9:23.web: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
9:23.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

9:24.web: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
9:24.kjv: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

9:25.web: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”
9:25.kjv: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

9:26.web: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead; so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”
9:26.kjv: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

bsb: and helped him to his feet,
9:27.web: But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.
9:27.kjv: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

9:28.web: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
9:28.kjv: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?

9:29.web: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing, except by prayer and fasting.”
9:29.kjv: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

9:30.web: They went out from there, and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it.
9:30.kjv: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.

9:31.web: For he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”
9:31.kjv: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.

9:32.web: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
9:32.kjv: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.

9:33.web: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”
9:33.kjv: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?

9:34.web: But they were silent, for they had disputed one with another on the way about who was the greatest.
9:34.kjv: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.

9:35.web: He sat down, and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”
9:35.kjv: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

bsb: Taking the child in His arms,
9:36.web: He took a little child, and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,
9:36.kjv: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,

9:37.web: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”
9:37.kjv: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.

9:38.web: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”
9:38.kjv: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

9:39.web: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name, and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
9:39.kjv: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

9:40.web: For whoever is not against us is on our side.
9:40.kjv: For he that is not against us is on our part.

9:41.web: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.
9:41.kjv: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

9:42.web: Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.
9:42.kjv: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

9:43.web: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,
9:43.kjv: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

9:44.web: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
9:44.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

9:45.web: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—
9:45.kjv: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

9:46.web: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
9:46.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

9:47.web: If your eye causes you to stumble, cast it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,
9:47.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

9:48.web: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
9:48.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

9:49.web: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.
9:49.kjv: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.

9:50.web: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
9:50.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

10:1.web: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.
10:1.kjv: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.

10:2.web: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
10:2.kjv: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.

10:3.web: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”
10:3.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?

bsb: a man to write his wife
10:4.web: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”
10:4.kjv: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.

10:5.web: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.
10:5.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.

10:6.web: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.
10:6.kjv: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.

10:7.web: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,
10:7.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;

10:8.web: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
10:8.kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.

10:9.web: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”
10:9.kjv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

10:10.web: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
10:10.kjv: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.

10:11.web: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery against her.
10:11.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.

10:12.web: If a woman herself divorces her husband, and marries another, she commits adultery.”
10:12.kjv: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.

10:13.web: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.
10:13.kjv: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.

10:14.web: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
10:14.kjv: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

10:15.web: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
10:15.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

bsb: He took the children in His arms,
10:16.web: He took them in his arms, and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
10:16.kjv: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.

10:17.web: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”
10:17.kjv: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

10:18.web: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.
10:18.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

10:19.web: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”
10:19.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

10:20.web: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”
10:20.kjv: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

10:21.web: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”
10:21.kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

10:22.web: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.
10:22.kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

10:23.web: Jesus looked around, and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”
10:23.kjv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

10:24.web: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard is it for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
10:24.kjv: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

10:25.web: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
10:25.kjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

10:26.web: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”
10:26.kjv: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?

10:27.web: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
10:27.kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

10:28.web: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all, and have followed you.”
10:28.kjv: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

10:29.web: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,
10:29.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel’s,

10:30.web: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time, houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.
10:30.kjv: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

10:31.web: But many who are first will be last; and the last first.”
10:31.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

10:32.web: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.
10:32.kjv: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

10:33.web: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.
10:33.kjv: Saying,Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

10:34.web: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”
10:34.kjv: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

10:35.web: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
10:35.kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

10:36.web: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
10:36.kjv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

10:37.web: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand, and one at your left hand, in your glory.”
10:37.kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

10:38.web: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
10:38.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

10:39.web: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;
10:39.kjv: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

10:40.web: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”
10:40.kjv: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

10:41.web: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant towards James and John.
10:41.kjv: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.

10:42.web: Jesus summoned them, and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
10:42.kjv: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

10:43.web: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.
10:43.kjv: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

10:44.web: Whoever of you wants to become first among you, shall be bondservant of all.
10:44.kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

10:45.web: For the Son of Man also came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
10:45.kjv: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

10:46.web: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.
10:46.kjv: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.

10:47.web: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
10:47.kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

10:48.web: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
10:48.kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

10:49.web: Jesus stood still, and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”
10:49.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

10:50.web: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
10:50.kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

10:51.web: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”
10:51.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

10:52.web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus on the way.
10:52.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

11:1.web: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
11:1.kjv: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

11:2.web: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him, and bring him.
11:2.kjv: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.

11:3.web: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”
11:3.kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

11:4.web: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.
11:4.kjv: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

11:5.web: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”
11:5.kjv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

11:6.web: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.
11:6.kjv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

11:7.web: They brought the young donkey to Jesus, and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.
11:7.kjv: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

11:8.web: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees, and spreading them on the road.
11:8.kjv: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

11:9.web: Those who went in front, and those who followed, cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!
11:9.kjv: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

11:10.web: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
11:10.kjv: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

11:11.web: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
11:11.kjv: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

11:12.web: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
11:12.kjv: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

11:13.web: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
11:13.kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

11:14.web: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.
11:14.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.

11:15.web: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple, and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables, and the seats of those who sold the doves.
11:15.kjv: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

11:16.web: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.
11:16.kjv: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.

11:17.web: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations?’ But you have made it a den of robbers!”
11:17.kjv: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

11:18.web: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
11:18.kjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

11:19.web: When evening came, he went out of the city.
11:19.kjv: And when even was come, he went out of the city.

11:20.web: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
11:20.kjv: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

11:21.web: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”
11:21.kjv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

11:22.web: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
11:22.kjv: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

11:23.web: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening; he shall have whatever he says.
11:23.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

11:24.web: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
11:24.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall havethem.

11:25.web: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
11:25.kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

11:26.web: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”
11:26.kjv: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

11:27.web: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders came to him,
11:27.kjv: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

11:28.web: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”
11:28.kjv: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

11:29.web: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
11:29.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

11:30.web: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”
11:30.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

11:31.web: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
11:31.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

11:32.web: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.
11:32.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

11:33.web: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
11:33.kjv: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

12:1.web: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.
12:1.kjv: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

12:2.web: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
12:2.kjv: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

12:3.web: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
12:3.kjv: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.

bsb: they struck him over the head
12:4.web: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
12:4.kjv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

12:5.web: Again he sent another; and they killed him; and many others, beating some, and killing some.
12:5.kjv: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

12:6.web: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
12:6.kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

12:7.web: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
12:7.kjv: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

12:8.web: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
12:8.kjv: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

12:9.web: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
12:9.kjv: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

12:10.web: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner.
12:10.kjv: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

12:11.web: This was from the Lord, it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
12:11.kjv: This was the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

12:12.web: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him, and went away.
12:12.kjv: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.

12:13.web: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
12:13.kjv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.

12:14.web: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
12:14.kjv: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

12:15.web: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”
12:15.kjv: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may seeit.

12:16.web: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
12:16.kjv: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar’s.

12:17.web: Jesus answered them, “Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.
12:17.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s. And they marvelled at him.

12:18.web: There came to him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection. They asked him, saying,
12:18.kjv: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

12:19.web: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies, and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.’
12:19.kjv: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

12:20.web: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
12:20.kjv: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

12:21.web: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;
12:21.kjv: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

12:22.web: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
12:22.kjv: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

12:23.web: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”
12:23.kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

12:24.web: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God?
12:24.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

12:25.web: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
12:25.kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

12:26.web: But about the dead, that they are raised; haven’t you read in the book of Moses, about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
12:26.kjv: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

12:27.web: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”
12:27.kjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

12:28.web: One of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together. Knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
12:28.kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

12:29.web: Jesus answered, “The greatest is, ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one:
12:29.kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

12:30.web: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.
12:30.kjv: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

12:31.web: The second is like this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
12:31.kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

12:32.web: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he,
12:32.kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

12:33.web: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
12:33.kjv: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

12:34.web: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.
12:34.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

12:35.web: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
12:35.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?

12:36.web: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
12:36.kjv: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

12:37.web: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.
12:37.kjv: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

12:38.web: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,
12:38.kjv: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

12:39.web: and the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts:
12:39.kjv: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

12:40.web: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
12:40.kjv: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

12:41.web: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.
12:41.kjv: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

bsb: a small fraction of a denarius.
12:42.web: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
12:42.kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

12:43.web: He called his disciples to himself, and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,
12:43.kjv: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

12:44.web: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”
12:44.kjv: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

13:1.web: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”
13:1.kjv: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

13:2.web: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”
13:2.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

13:3.web: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,
13:3.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

13:4.web: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”
13:4.kjv: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

13:5.web: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
13:5.kjv: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

13:6.web: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.
13:6.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

13:7.web: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.
13:7.kjv: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

13:8.web: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.
13:8.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

13:9.web: But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.
13:9.kjv: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

13:10.web: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.
13:10.kjv: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

13:11.web: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand, or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
13:11.kjv: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

13:12.web: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
13:12.kjv: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

13:13.web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.
13:13.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

13:14.web: But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,
13:14.kjv: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:

13:15.web: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.
13:15.kjv: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:

13:16.web: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
13:16.kjv: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

13:17.web: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!
13:17.kjv: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

13:18.web: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.
13:18.kjv: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

13:19.web: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.
13:19.kjv: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

13:20.web: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.
13:20.kjv: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

13:21.web: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.
13:21.kjv: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

13:22.web: For there will arise false christs and false prophets, and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
13:22.kjv: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

13:23.web: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
13:23.kjv: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

13:24.web: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,
13:24.kjv: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

13:25.web: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
13:25.kjv: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

13:26.web: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
13:26.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

13:27.web: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.
13:27.kjv: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

13:28.web: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;
13:28.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

13:29.web: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.
13:29.kjv: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

13:30.web: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.
13:30.kjv: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

13:31.web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
13:31.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

13:32.web: But of that day or that hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
13:32.kjv: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

13:33.web: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
13:33.kjv: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

13:34.web: “It is like a man, traveling to another country, having left his house, and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.
13:34.kjv: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

13:35.web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;
13:35.kjv: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

13:36.web: lest coming suddenly he might find you sleeping.
13:36.kjv: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

13:37.web: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch.”
13:37.kjv: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

14:1.web: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception, and kill him.
14:1.kjv: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

14:2.web: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”
14:2.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

14:3.web: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar, and poured it over his head.
14:3.kjv: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

14:4.web: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?
14:4.kjv: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

14:5.web: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and given to the poor.” They grumbled against her.
14:5.kjv: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

14:6.web: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.
14:6.kjv: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

14:7.web: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.
14:7.kjv: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

14:8.web: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
14:8.kjv: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

14:9.web: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”
14:9.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

14:10.web: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.
14:10.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

14:11.web: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
14:11.kjv: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

bsb: of the Feast of Unleavened Bread,
14:12.web: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”
14:12.kjv: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

14:13.web: He sent two of his disciples, and said to them, “Go into the city, and there you will meet a man carrying a pitcher of water. Follow him,
14:13.kjv: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

14:14.web: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
14:14.kjv: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

14:15.web: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”
14:15.kjv: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

14:16.web: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
14:16.kjv: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

14:17.web: When it was evening he came with the twelve.
14:17.kjv: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.

14:18.web: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”
14:18.kjv: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

14:19.web: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
14:19.kjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

14:20.web: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
14:20.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

14:21.web: For the Son of Man goes, even as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
14:21.kjv: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

14:22.web: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed, he broke it, and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”
14:22.kjv: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

14:23.web: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.
14:23.kjv: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

14:24.web: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
14:24.kjv: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

14:25.web: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”
14:25.kjv: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

bsb: when they had sung a hymn,
14:26.web: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
14:26.kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

14:27.web: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
14:27.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

14:28.web: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
14:28.kjv: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

14:29.web: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”
14:29.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

14:30.web: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you, that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
14:30.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

14:31.web: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.
14:31.kjv: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

14:32.web: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I pray.”
14:32.kjv: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

14:33.web: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
14:33.kjv: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

14:34.web: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch.”
14:34.kjv: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

14:35.web: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
14:35.kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

14:36.web: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
14:36.kjv: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

14:37.web: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
14:37.kjv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

14:38.web: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
14:38.kjv: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

14:39.web: Again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.
14:39.kjv: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

14:40.web: Again he returned, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they didn’t know what to answer him.
14:40.kjv: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

14:41.web: He came the third time, and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
14:41.kjv: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

14:42.web: Arise, let us be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
14:42.kjv: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

14:43.web: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
14:43.kjv: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priest and the scribes and the elders.

14:44.web: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”
14:44.kjv: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

14:45.web: When he had come, immediately he came to him, and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
14:45.kjv: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

14:46.web: They laid their hands on him, and seized him.
14:46.kjv: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

14:47.web: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
14:47.kjv: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

14:48.web: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?
14:48.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

14:49.web: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”
14:49.kjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

14:50.web: They all left him, and fled.
14:50.kjv: And they all forsook him, and fled.

14:51.web: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,
14:51.kjv: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:

14:52.web: but he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
14:52.kjv: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

14:53.web: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.
14:53.kjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

14:54.web: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.
14:54.kjv: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

14:55.web: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.
14:55.kjv: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

14:56.web: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.
14:56.kjv: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

14:57.web: Some stood up, and gave false testimony against him, saying,
14:57.kjv: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,

14:58.web: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”
14:58.kjv: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

14:59.web: Even so, their testimony did not agree.
14:59.kjv: But neither so did their witness agree together.

14:60.web: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”
14:60.kjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

14:61.web: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”
14:61.kjv: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

14:62.web: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”
14:62.kjv: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

14:63.web: The high priest tore his clothes, and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?
14:63.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

14:64.web: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.
14:64.kjv: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

14:65.web: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.
14:65.kjv: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.

14:66.web: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
14:66.kjv: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

14:67.web: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him, and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
14:67.kjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

14:68.web: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know, nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.
14:68.kjv: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

14:69.web: The maid saw him, and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”
14:69.kjv: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

14:70.web: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”
14:70.kjv: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.

14:71.web: But he began to curse, and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
14:71.kjv: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.

14:72.web: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the word, how that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.
14:72.kjv: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.

15:1.web: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
15:1.kjv: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.

15:2.web: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
15:2.kjv: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.

15:3.web: The chief priests accused him of many things.
15:3.kjv: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

15:4.web: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”
15:4.kjv: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

15:5.web: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.
15:5.kjv: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

15:6.web: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.
15:6.kjv: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

15:7.web: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
15:7.kjv: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

15:8.web: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
15:8.kjv: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

15:9.web: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
15:9.kjv: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

15:10.web: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
15:10.kjv: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

15:11.web: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.
15:11.kjv: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

15:12.web: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”
15:12.kjv: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

15:13.kjv: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

15:14.web: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”
15:14.kjv: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

15:15.web: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.
15:15.kjv: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.

15:16.web: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.
15:16.kjv: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

15:17.web: They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
15:17.kjv: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,

15:18.web: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
15:18.kjv: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

15:19.web: They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
15:19.kjv: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.

15:20.web: When they had mocked him, they took the purple off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.
15:20.kjv: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

15:21.web: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them, that he might bear his cross.
15:21.kjv: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

15:22.web: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”
15:22.kjv: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

15:23.web: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.
15:23.kjv: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

15:24.web: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.
15:24.kjv: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

15:25.web: It was the third hour, and they crucified him.
15:25.kjv: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

15:26.web: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
15:26.kjv: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

15:27.web: With him they crucified two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.
15:27.kjv: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

15:28.web: The Scripture was fulfilled, which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”
15:28.kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

bsb: You who are going to destroy
