15:29.web: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads, and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days,
15:29.kjv: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

15:30.web: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”
15:30.kjv: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

15:31.web: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.
15:31.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

15:32.web: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.
15:32.kjv: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

15:33.web: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
15:33.kjv: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

15:34.web: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
15:34.kjv: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

15:35.web: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”
15:35.kjv: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

bsb: and held it up for Jesus to drink,
15:36.web: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”
15:36.kjv: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

15:37.web: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.
15:37.kjv: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

15:38.web: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.
15:38.kjv: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

15:39.web: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
15:39.kjv: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

15:40.web: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
15:40.kjv: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

15:41.web: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
15:41.kjv: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

15:42.web: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
15:42.kjv: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

15:43.web: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
15:43.kjv: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

15:44.web: Pilate marveled if he were already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.
15:44.kjv: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

15:45.web: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
15:45.kjv: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

15:46.web: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
15:46.kjv: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

15:47.web: Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.
15:47.kjv: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.

16:1.web: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
16:1.kjv: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

16:2.web: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
16:2.kjv: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

16:3.web: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
16:3.kjv: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

16:4.web: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.
16:4.kjv: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

16:5.web: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were amazed.
16:5.kjv: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

16:6.web: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen. He is not here. Behold, the place where they laid him!
16:6.kjv: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

16:7.web: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”
16:7.kjv: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

16:8.web: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.
16:8.kjv: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.

16:9.web: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
16:9.kjv: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

16:10.web: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
16:10.kjv: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

16:11.web: When they heard that he was alive, and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.
16:11.kjv: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

16:12.web: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
16:12.kjv: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

16:13.web: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.
16:13.kjv: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.

16:14.web: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
16:14.kjv: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

16:15.web: He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
16:15.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

16:16.web: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
16:16.kjv: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

16:17.web: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;
16:17.kjv: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

16:18.web: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”
16:18.kjv: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

16:19.web: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.
16:19.kjv: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

16:20.web: They went out, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
16:20.kjv: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
